repo:objectstack#6 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjQkY5yXZrN9BEA3rEK ## Contract review Served-tier: `TIER_DEFAULT` Head-sha: `4dd686917443aaea5753b9fb858f44910b279fff` Local-runs: none Scope: ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/ar.ts, ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/de.ts, ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/en.ts, ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/es.ts, ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/fr.ts, ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/ja.ts, ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/ko.ts, ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/pt-BR.ts, ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/ru.ts, ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/zh-Hans.ts, ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/zh-Hant.ts + ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/organizations/orgErrorMessage.ts, ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/organizations/CreateWorkspaceDialog.tsx, ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/organizations/__tests__/orgErrorMessage-4474.test.ts, ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/organizations/__tests__/CreateWorkspaceDialog.test.tsx + read, not reviewed: .changeset/34221-unpaid-org-limit-refusal.md Security-touching: no Rule-change-verified: none First record on this PR. The face is the declaration alone: `record-recognisers.mjs --paths` on the 16 changed paths decides no schema and no governed path, and the changeset line carries the `(widening)` arm, so the face is `declaration` and the tier is `TIER_DEFAULT`. Inputs: card #34221, triage 7213420175, claim 7227246396, dev report 7227947197, the PR body, `git diff c151c499 4dd68691`, the cited code at the head, cloud `main` `packages/service-cloud/src/unpaid-organization-cap.ts`, and the check-runs on this head. Nothing was built or run. ### ① Derived judgments - `Clause-②: yes (widening)`: RIGHT. - `@object-ui/i18n` publishes the packs on `./locales` and `./locales/*`, and `TranslationKeys` is derived from `en`. Two new keys in every pack enlarge that surface and remove nothing. - The new app-shell symbols (`UNPAID_ORGANIZATION_LIMIT_REACHED`, `readOrgCreateNextStep`, `OrgCreateNextStep`, `OrgErrorEntry.preferUserMessage`) are not published. `orgErrorMessage.ts` is not re-exported from `src/index.ts`, and the package's `exports` map has `.` and `./styles.css` only. The declaration is right to name i18n alone. - Same spelling as the precedent on main, `.changeset/34171-managed-password-refusal-copy.md` (#37965). - `Metadata-protocol: none`: RIGHT. Nothing a metadata author writes changes. No `Skills-docs:` line is owed. - The claim said `Clause-②: no`. The diff decides, and the diff adds keys to a published package. The claim was wrong, the PR is right. - Locale parity: 11 packs (ar, de, en, es, fr, ja, ko, pt-BR, ru, zh-Hans, zh-Hant). Each gains exactly one `workspace.viewPlans` and one `organization.errors.unpaidOrganizationLimitReached`, at the same nesting, next to `multiOrgDisabled` and `organizationLimitReached`. No key removed or renamed. - Producer shape, read on cloud `main`: 403, flat `{ code, message, userMessage, details: { unpaid_organization_limit, unpaid_organizations, next_step } }`, `userMessage === message`, `next_step` is `upgrade_to_team | contact_support`. The console's two-value set matches the producer's type. - The path to the dialog holds: `createOrganization` throws through `toAuthError`, which carries `code`, a non-blank `userMessage` and a plain-object `details`. `createWithGeneratedSlug` rethrows anything that is not a slug collision. ### ② Semver level - `@object-ui/i18n` patch, `@object-ui/app-shell` patch, `@object-ui/console` patch: right. AGENTS.md Post-Task step 3: kind `none` takes `patch`, and a non-protocol widening ships `patch`. - Not BREAKING: no banner, no migration and no ADR-0087 marker are owed. - The changeset and the PR body carry the same two declaration lines. `Check Changeset` is success on this head. ### ③ Boundary flags - `preferUserMessage` is safe. - The sentence is rendered as a React text child of `

`. No `dangerouslySetInnerHTML`, no markdown, no interpolation into an attribute. Markup in a `userMessage` from any producer shows as text. - It adds no trust. For an unmapped code the dialog already shows `err.message` verbatim from the same server. Before this diff, this very refusal showed the same producer sentence by that route. - The flag is set on one row. `producerUserMessage` requires a non-blank string, else the pack key. - `next_step` is read for this code only. `readOrgCreateNextStep` returns `undefined` unless `errorCode(err)` is `UNPAID_ORGANIZATION_LIMIT_REACHED`, and accepts only the two known strings. The sentence is never parsed. A test pins `details.next_step: 'upgrade_to_team'` on the better-auth code as no step. - The link is hidden when no upgrade URL is served. The catch sets `upgradeUrl` to `getUpgradeUrl()` only for `upgrade_to_team`, and the render is `error && upgradeUrl`. The state is cleared on open and on each submit. Unlike the four other consumers, there is no `cloudConsoleUrl()` fallback, so the console composes no address. - The link target is the runtime config's `upgradeUrl`, taken verbatim by the console. `http:` / `https:` is enforced at the producer (`isAbsoluteHttpUrl` in `packages/cloud-connection/src/runtime-config-plugin.ts`). This is the existing contract of the key and this diff does not change it. `rel="noopener noreferrer"` is set. - CONTROL: the `YOU_HAVE_REACHED_THE_MAXIMUM_NUMBER_OF_ORGANIZATIONS` row is byte-identical. Two tests pin it: it maps to `organization.errors.organizationLimitReached`, ignores a `userMessage`, and draws no link. - The claim's file surface covers the diff: `orgErrorMessage.ts`, the dialog, their tests, the i18n packs, one changeset. - `Security-touching: no`: no hunk teaches permission, credential or authentication behaviour. The diff shows a refusal the server already made. - SQL push-down: no data access in the diff. Nothing to report. - Author: `objectstack-fleet[bot]`. - Main: the head merges without conflict (merge-tree, no checkout). - Check-runs on this head, read at 2026-11-27T20:57:04Z: 55 runs, 13 success, 13 skipped, 29 in progress, none failed. - Success: Check Changeset, PR-body guards, Governed Surface Queue Guard, Dogfood Regression Gate, Test Core, Type Check · workspace, Type Check · debt ledger, Build UI Deps, Plan Test UI shards, Live E2E UI, Check PR Size, Auto Label, filter. - Not yet answered: Type Check UI, Lint UI, Build & E2E UI, Test UI 1/16 to 16/16, the Lint families, Type Check · source gates and consumer gates. - "All green" is not established on this head. It is the seat's to read before the PR is queued. Findings. None is must-fix or should-fix. - N1 (nit, a card). The producer writes four locales (`en`, `zh-CN`, `ja-JP`, `es-ES`) and English otherwise. It picks by `?locale=`, else `Accept-Language`; the auth client sends neither from the console's language. - So a console session in de, fr, ko, ru, ar, pt-BR or zh-Hant shows the English producer sentence, and its translated pack sentence is not reached against the current producer. A session whose console language differs from the browser's can get the browser's. - This is what the card asks (prefer the producer's sentence, ruling C on #32440) and it is not a regression: before the diff the same sentence was shown. The producer sentence also carries the numbers and the exact step, which the pack cannot. - The changeset and PR body say "in the request's language", which holds for four locales. Prose face, not blocking. Carrier: cloud (more locales), or the console sending its language on the create. - N2 (nit, a card). On the control plane's own console, where this cap fires, no `upgradeUrl` is served today, so the link stays hidden. The PR body states it and names the carrier (cloud), but the dev report says it was not filed. The seat files it through `filing-gate.md`. - N3 (nit, accepted). Card item 2 (warn before the click) is not done. The card makes it conditional on the host stating the limit, and neither `/auth/config` nor discovery does. `Fixes #34221` is right. - N4 (nit, bookkeeping). The seat's note of the declaration change against claim 7227246396 is owed in its L1 record. The dev report already names the deviation. Implemented-by: `claude/issue-34221-unpaid-org-limit` Reviewed-by: `session_01Q4EjjQkY5yXZrN9BEA3rEK` **VERDICT: PASS**

## Contract review

Served-tier: `TIER_DEFAULT`
Head-sha: `df235f646feb5fe1568c1bd8ccf72ff03cb69d36`
Local-runs: none
Scope: ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/ar.ts, ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/de.ts, ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/en.ts, ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/es.ts, ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/fr.ts, ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/ja.ts, ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/ko.ts, ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/pt-BR.ts, ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/ru.ts, ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/zh-Hans.ts, ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/zh-Hant.ts + ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/organizations/orgErrorMessage.ts, ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/organizations/CreateWorkspaceDialog.tsx, ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/organizations/__tests__/orgErrorMessage-4474.test.ts, ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/organizations/__tests__/CreateWorkspaceDialog.test.tsx + read, not reviewed: .changeset/34221-unpaid-org-limit-refusal.md, ui/docs/adr/0060-product-neutral-renderer.md, ui/packages/app-shell/src/__tests__/product-neutral-renderer.ratchet.test.ts
Security-touching: no
Rule-change-verified: none

Delta round by the reviewer of record 7228012752 (PASS at `4dd68691`). That head went red in CI on two tests the record did not foresee: `zh-hant-generated` (Test UI 8/16 or 10/16) and the ADR-0060 ratchet. The record read the 11-pack parity and missed both that zh-Hant is generated and that `workspace` is a frozen namespace. Inputs here: `git diff 4dd68691 df235f64` (two commits, 14 files, 16 lines each way), dev report 7228358190, the PR body, ADR-0060 and its ratchet test at the head, and the check-runs on this head. Nothing was built or run.

### ① Derived judgments

- The delta is three things and no more:
  - the link key moved from `workspace.viewPlans` to `organization.viewPlans` in all 11 packs, in the dialog's one `t()` call and in the changeset's two mentions. The values are byte-identical in the 10 packs other than zh-Hant;
  - zh-Hant's two new values are now the generator's: `帳號` became `賬號`, `方案` became `套餐`, `查看` became `檢視`;
  - one test line reads the zh-Hans pack as `{ organization: { viewPlans: string } }`.
- `orgErrorMessage.ts`, its test, the dialog's state and render logic, and the `unpaidOrganizationLimitReached` key are untouched. The judgments of 7228012752 on `preferUserMessage`, `next_step`, the hidden link and the CONTROL row stand as written there.
- `Clause-②: yes (widening)`: still RIGHT. The key was never released under `workspace`, so the move removes nothing published. `Metadata-protocol: none`: unchanged.
- Parity at this head: each of the 11 packs has exactly one `viewPlans`, under top-level `organization`, and exactly one `unpaidOrganizationLimitReached`, under `organization.errors`. No `workspace.viewPlans` is left in `ui/packages` or the changeset.
- `organization` is not frozen, and the move is the remedy ADR-0060 names.
  - The ADR's frozen set lists `organizations` (plural), `workspace` and `environment`. It names `organization` (singular) under "Considered and not frozen", because the layout's indicator and switcher and `@object-ui/auth` read it too.
  - The ratchet's two locale rules both pass on the new key: it sits under no frozen namespace, and `viewPlans` does not lead with a product word (`cloud`, `hotcrm`).
  - The allowlist, the ADR and the ratchet test are not in the diff.
  - The copy is neutral: "View plans and upgrade" names no product, plan or number, and the link is drawn for any host that serves `upgradeUrl`.
  - The home fits. The frozen `console/organizations/**` pages already read `organization.settings`, `.accept`, `.invitations`, `.members` and `.errors`.

### ② Semver level

- Unchanged: `@object-ui/i18n`, `@object-ui/app-shell` and `@object-ui/console` at patch. Right for a non-protocol widening.
- The changeset and the PR body carry the same two declaration lines, and both now name `organization.viewPlans`. `Check Changeset` is success on this head.

### ③ Boundary flags

- The ratchet states what it cannot see: growth inside an existing file under a frozen directory, and copy under a neutral name. Both describe this diff, so this is the review's call. It is accepted: card #34221 directs the change in these two files, and the copy is neutral as read in ①. No ADR amendment is owed.
- zh-Hant was not regenerated here (`Local-runs: none`). The proof is CI: Test UI 8/16 and 10/16, the two shards red at `4dd68691`, are both success on this head.
- The dev report says `48298e0e` was pushed with the app-shell type-check failing (TS2352 on the test cast). `df235f64` fixes it, and `Type Check UI` is success on this head. No intermediate head was queued.
- `Security-touching: no`, as before. SQL push-down: nothing in the delta.
- Main: the head merges without conflict (merge-tree, no checkout). Auto-merge is not armed.
- Check-runs on this head, read at 2026-11-27T21:37:13Z: 61 runs, 41 success, 15 skipped, 5 in progress, none failed.
  - Success includes Type Check UI, Lint UI, Build & E2E UI, Live E2E UI, Test Core, every Lint and Type Check family, Check Changeset, PR-body guards, Governed Surface Queue Guard, and Test UI 3, 4, 7 to 15 of 16.
  - Not yet answered: Test UI 1/16, 2/16, 5/16, 6/16 and 16/16. At `4dd68691` the failed shards were 8/16 and 10/16 only.
  - "All green" is not yet established on this head. It is the seat's to read before the PR is queued.

Findings of record 7228012752, at this head. No must-fix, no should-fix.

- N1 (open, a card). The producer writes four locales and picks by the browser's language. Unchanged.
- N2 (open, a card). The control plane serves no `upgradeUrl` today, so the link stays hidden where this cap fires. Unchanged; the dev report again names it as not filed.
- N3 (accepted). Card item 2 not done. Unchanged.
- N4 (open, bookkeeping). The seat's note of the declaration change against claim 7227246396.
- N5 (new, nit, prose). The PR body's Verification section still reads "Commit `4dd68691` (all local readings below were taken on this head)". The readings for this head are in dev report 7228358190. The seat corrects the line or points at that report.

Implemented-by: `claude/issue-34221-unpaid-org-limit`
Reviewed-by: `session_01Q4EjjQkY5yXZrN9BEA3rEK`

**VERDICT: PASS**

- 控制台「新建工作区」时，若账号的不付费组织数已满（云端新拒绝码），对话框显示云端给的本地化说明，并在主机提供升级地址时给出「查看方案并升级」链接；不再显示通用错误。
- 旧的组织数上限报错不变。控制平面目前不提供升级地址，所以那里暂时只有说明没有链接（已在 cloud 立卡 #5173）；云端只出四种语言的说明（cloud#5174）。
